```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
beagle_available <- nzchar(Sys.getenv("BEAGLE_PATH"))
library(beagler)
```

`run_beagle()` wraps Beagle 5.x via `processx`. The function captures
stdout, stderr, runtime, and a structured run record (input/output
SHA-256 hashes, command argv, versions) into a `beagler_run` object.

This vignette runs against a real Beagle install when `BEAGLE_PATH` is
set; otherwise it explains the call without executing it.

## Locate Beagle

The package looks for Beagle in three places:

```{r, eval = beagle_available}
beagle_version()
```

If you don't have Beagle yet:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
install_beagle()           # downloads pinned 5.4 jar to user cache
```

That writes the JAR to `tools::R_user_dir("beagler", "cache")`. Override
with `BEAGLE_PATH` or pass `beagle_jar = ` to `run_beagle()`.

## A small phasing run

Phase a tiny VCF with no reference panel:

```{r, eval = beagle_available}
library(beagler)

gt <- system.file("extdata", "tiny.vcf", package = "beagler")
if (!nzchar(gt) || !file.exists(gt)) {
  # Build a tiny gt VCF on the fly from the bundled CSV fixtures.
  csv <- system.file("extdata", "tiny.csv", package = "beagler")
  map <- system.file("extdata", "tiny_map.tsv", package = "beagler")
  gt <- tempfile(fileext = ".vcf")
  csv_to_vcf(csv, map, gt)
}

out_dir <- tempfile("beagler_demo_")
dir.create(out_dir)
out_prefix <- file.path(out_dir, "phased")

run <- run_beagle(gt, out_prefix, mode = "phase", nthreads = 2L)
run$status
run$runtime_sec
run$output_paths
```

## What's in `beagler_run`

```{r, eval = beagle_available}
run
```

`run$run_record` is the path to a JSON v1.0.0 audit record that's safe
to share alongside the output:

```{r, eval = beagle_available}
jsonlite::fromJSON(run$run_record)$versions
```

## Reference panels

Reference panels for `ref =` must be `.vcf.gz` (BGZF) with a sibling
`.tbi` index. Beagle can't read plain `.vcf` references.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
run_beagle(
  gt,
  out_prefix,
  ref = "panel.vcf.gz",        # must have panel.vcf.gz.tbi
  map = "genetic_map.txt",     # PLINK genetic map (cM)
  mode = "impute",
  nthreads = 4L
)
```

## Failure modes

Pre-flight VCF validation runs `validate_vcf(target = "beagle")` on
`gt`. If it fails, `run_beagle()` raises immediately and points you at
`repair_vcf()`. Beagle's own complaints (after Java launches) come back
as a `beagler_run` with `status != 0` — `print()` shows the tail of
stderr.
